create_DifferentiableRigidBody: create a DifferentiableRigidBody instance from a rigid body parameters dictionary with inertia and joint axis
run_forward_kinematics: run recursive forward kinematics on a DifferentiableRigidBody to compute transformations for all descendant links
update_joint_state: update the joint state of a DifferentiableRigidBody with position and velocity tensors
update_joint_acc: update the joint acceleration of a DifferentiableRigidBody with an acceleration tensor
build_kinematic_tree: build a kinematic tree by calling set_parent and add_child on DifferentiableRigidBody instances
